text: The laser that powers a photonic accelerator runs off an electrical supply at only about 10-25% ___ efficiency, so its optical energy must be divided by that factor to account for its true cost at the wall plug.
explanation: Typical laser wall-plug (electrical-to-optical) efficiency is 10-25%, so the laser's optical energy is divided by the WPE to get the real electrical cost — a required normalization in fair benchmarking. This is why the laser term in the master energy-per-MAC equation carries a divide-by-WPE factor.
